entries.title: Missing proof stays concise until you open its record
entries.body: When a builder asks to proceed without live proof, the card keeps what your click grants in view. The recorded gap starts closed; open it to read what is missing, what was tried and ways to close it. Accepting still records no live pass and merges nothing.

picture.alt: A device check decision keeps the untested scenario and no-pass, no-merge limits visible above the closed The recorded gap row.
